novel_mechanics_found: Level 5's top-middle green-center ring was independently reached and consumed live by entering it horizontally from the west after a launcher placed the player at x39,y5; it genuinely resets the counter to 21. Frame-by-frame routing also pinned down why setting color 8 before the upper-left ring fails: the third pinwheel entry leaves the player at x29,y25 with only 10 actions, while the forced launcher-and-upper-corridor route needs 11 actions to collect that ring. The previously banked split-transform mechanic was reconfirmed live: upper-pad state [110,011,101] plus lower contact sequence 443 produces target shape [101,110,011].
narrative: The resolver supplied a 244-action prefix, and I replayed it from two genuinely fresh environments; both replays reached frame.levels_completed=4. On L5 I reconstructed the launcher graph from rendered frames, independently consumed all three reset-ring types across live attempts, reproduced the exact target-shape construction, and tested a compact color-8-first splice. That final splice reached the third pinwheel state in the expected position but proved one counter action short of the upper-left reset, matching the prior warning. I stopped at 654/700 calls: the 46 remaining calls cannot execute the known 50-plus-action L5 route or replay the 244-action prefix for a reproduction gate. No L5 win was observed or claimed.
gotchas: L5 counter capacity is 21 actions, not L4's 42; blocked moves drain it, and the action after it reaches zero restarts or ends the game when lives are gone.
The upper-left ring and lower-left ring each reset the L5 counter to 21 and disappear after collection.
To reach the upper-left ring efficiently, set color only to E (two pinwheel entries), then route through the upper corridor; setting full color 8 first is one action too expensive.
Upper shape pad recipe from the fresh shape: enter, exit west, re-enter to obtain [110,011,101].
Lower orientation-sprite recipe observed live: with that base shape and the player at x14,y35, actions 443 produce required [101,110,011].
The lower-left ring cell blocks a direct left move. Exit with up,up,left,up,up before continuing toward the upper corridor.
The top-middle ring is collectible: a launcher can place the player at x39,y5, then ACTION4 enters the ring horizontally and resets the counter to 21.

From the third pinwheel entry at x29,y25, the upper-left ring is forced through an 11-action launcher/corridor route; only 10 counter actions remain, so color 8 must be financed by the top-middle reset rather than set before the upper-left reset.
